856-5631-5776-8249.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Skeleton Crew trigger.
Resolve the Skeleton Crew trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

5195-7683-7910.notablePrerequisites: You have another nonland card in hand with the mana to cast it and applicable targets if needed.
5195-7683-7910.description:
Cast any spell by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Bilbo's Gambit by paying its mana cost, targeting the spell cast in step 1.
Bilbo's Gambit's storm ability and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bilbo's Gambit trigger, copying it for each spell cast before it this turn. Choose to have each copy target the original Bilbo's Gambit.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers for each copy generated, creating that many Treasure tokens.
Resolve the first Bilbo's Gambit copy, returning the original Bilbo's Gambit to your hand.
All other copies of Bilbo's Gambit fizzle due to having no legal target.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat from step 2.

618-728-4344.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Lumbering Battlement.
When the Lumbering Battlement token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the Lumbering Battlement token.
When the Lumbering Battlement token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

2098-5531-7812.easyPrerequisites: You're able to play a land this turn.
2098-5531-7812.description:
Play Vesuva. Choose to have it enter as a tapped copy of Lumra.
Put Vesuva into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Vesuva's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Choose to have Vesuva enters as a tapped copy of Lumra.
Repeat from step 2.

4399-4770-5998-6752.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Grand Arbiter Augustin IV.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Haliya trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Haliya trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4770-5998-6752.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

413-1263-4871-6255.notablePrerequisites:
You have attacked this turn.
You have max speed.
413-1263-4871-6255.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Zahur and Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodsoaked Champion enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Repeat.

215-969-3291.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least 6.
215-969-3291.description:
Activate Karametra's Acolyte by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Karametra's Acolyte from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Karametra's Acolyte by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3099-4762-4772-7315.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Doubling Season and High Score.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

891-2292-3055.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Gift of Immortality from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1.
Repeat.

821-5220-6900-7286.description:
Activate Mogg Fanatic by sacrificing it.
When Mogg Fanatic dies, Mortuary and South Wind Avatar trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Mogg Fanatic from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
South Wind Avatar triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Mogg Fanatic ability.
Cast Mogg Fanatic from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

3991-4050-4605-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {4}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Faceless Butcher and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Faceless Butcher trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Faceless Butcher that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Faceless Butcher token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Faceless Butcher.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Faceless Butcher token
When the Faceless Butcher token dies, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3678-6797-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
3678-6797-6879.description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending the land that entered.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the earthbended land.
Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending the land that entered.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.

618-3580-3967.description:
Cast Lightning Crafter by paying {3}{R}.
When Lightning Crafter enters the battlefield, its champion ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Lightning Crafter with haste.
When the token Lightning Crafter enters the battlefield, its champion ability triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki.
Activate the token Lightning Crafter by tapping it, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the token Lightning Crafter.
When the token Lightning Crafter leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 3.

851-3951-4875-5703.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr
851-3951-4875-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating two tapped and attacking copies of Éomer.
Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing you to get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

678-5670-6533.notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls a black and/or red creature.
678-5670-6533.description:
Cast Honorable Scout by paying {W}.
When Honorable Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to gain at least 2 life.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Honorable Scout
When Honorable Scout dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Honorable Scout from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

695-813-2103.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Capture of Jingzhou and Settle Beyond Reality.
695-813-2103.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Settle Beyond Reality by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou and Settle Beyond Reality from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

2196-2821-3573-5803.notablePrerequisites:
Kitsa has power 2 or greater and does not have summoning sickness.
You are able to produce at least {3}{U} between Tolarian Academy and up to one additional land.
2196-2821-3573-5803.description:
Activate Tolarian Academy and up to other land by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Cast Frantic Search by paying {2}{U}.
Kitsa's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Holding priority, activate Kitsa's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Frantic Search.
Resolve the copy of Frantic Search, causing you to loot twice and untap Minamo, Tolarian Academy and up to one other land.
Activate Tolarian Academy and up to one other land by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U} and tapping it, untapping Kitsa.
Repeat from step 4.

2538-3682-4009-5911.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three artifacts.
You have no other cards in hand.
2538-3682-4009-5911.description:
Activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast Mox Opal by paying its mana cost.
Flubs triggers, causing you to return Mox Amber from the battlefield to your hand, and causing each opponent to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind.
Activate Mox Opal by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast Mox Amber by paying its mana cost.
Flubs triggers, causing you to return Mox Opal from the battlefield to your hand, and causing each opponent to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind.
Repeat.

1449-2092-4499.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 2 or greater.
1449-2092-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking Plundering Barbarian.
When Plundering Barbarian enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Grist, Voracious Larva // Grist, the Plague Swarm

1887-3305-3967-4022-5926.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Body Launderer.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability triggers, returning Grist, Voracious Larva from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Grist, Voracious Larva enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to pay {G} to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Grist, the Plague Swarm with six loyalty counters due to Vorinclex.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Grist, the Plague Swarm's third loyalty ability by removing six loyalty counters from it.
Grist, the Plague Swarm is put into your graveyard as a state-based action due to having zero loyalty.
Resolve the Grist, the Plague Swarm ability, creating a token copy of each creature card in your graveyard that is a 1/1 Insect.
When the Grist, Voracious Larva and Hidden Herbalist tokens enter the battlefield, the Hidden Herbalist token triggers once and the Grist, Voracious Larva token triggers for each token created this way.
Resolve all Grist, Voracious Larva triggers, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the Hidden Herbalist trigger, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the Grist, Voracious Larva token.
Repeat from step 1, sacrificing a Body Launderer token instead.

643-1641-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Promised Kannushi, adding {G}.
When Promised Kannushi dies, its soulshift ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Promised Kannushi by paying {G}.
Repeat.

141-4493.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
141-4493.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Irenicus's Vile Duplication
141-4493.description:
Cast Irenicus's Vile Duplication by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{U}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Irenicus's Vile Duplication, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Irenicus's Vile Duplication, creating a token copy of Naru Meha that isn't legendary.
Repeat from step 3.

320-905-2429.description:
Activate Tetzimoc by paying {B} and revealing it from your hand, targeting a creature an opponent controls.
Horobi triggers, destroying that creature.
The creature dies, triggering Revel in Riches' first ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Plargg, Dean of Chaos // Augusta, Dean of Order

3094-4784-5089.notablePrerequisites:
Dean of Order.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}.
You control a creature that can attack this turn.
3094-4784-5089.description:
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing Lithoform Engine to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Move to your combat phase, and declare any creature you control as an attacker, triggering Augusta.
Holding priority, activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Augusta's ability.
Resolve the copy of Augusta's ability, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat from step 3.

738-1202-2034-4733.description:
Sacrifice Myr Moonvessel to Ashnod's Altar, adding {C}{C}.
Myr Moonvessel and Dictate of Erebos trigger.
Resolve Myr Moonvessel's trigger, adding {C}.
Resolve Dictate of Erebos's trigger, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
Glissa triggers at least once, allowing you to return Myr Moonvessel to your hand.
Cast Myr Moonvessel by paying {1}.
Repeat until your opponents no longer control any creatures.
